items.t: GSK (LSE:GSK) Faces A New Risk As Its AI Supplier Turns Drug Rival
items.sum: GSK (LSE:GSK) is collaborating with Anthropic, the developer of Claude AI, to support parts of its drug discovery work. Anthropic is also building internal drug development programs that could compete directly with therapies GSK aims to bring to market. items.t: GSK (LSE:GSK) Wins EMA Panel Backing For Bexsero Booster From Age 10
items.sum: GSK (LSE:GSK) received a positive opinion from the EMA's CHMP on an updated Bexsero label for adolescents and young adults. The panel backed a single Bexsero booster dose for individuals aged 10 years and older, supported by Phase IIIb trial data.
